profile.reading:
Cloud Center Andalucia is the name OpenStreetMap records for the data centre building on Calle Pago de Cambea in Granada, southern Spain, and the operator behind it can be identified directly. The domain cloudcenterandalucia.es now redirects to trevenque.es, and Trevenque Group lists its data centre site at Calle Pago de Cambea nave 13, Parque Empresarial Cortijo del Conde, Poligono Sur, 18015 Granada, the same street the mapped building carries. The facility is marketed today as Trevenque Data Center.

Trevenque was founded in Granada in November 1992 by five computing professionals who set out to act as an outsourced IT department for small and medium sized businesses, beginning with management software for Spanish bookshops. The company places the data centre in its 2012 to 2016 strategic plan and describes it as the first data centre in Granada. The group head office is separate, at Calle Andres Segovia 53 in Granada, and Trevenque also lists offices in Almeria, Malaga and Mexico City.

Trevenque publishes physical detail for the site rather than headline capacity numbers. It describes more than 1,000 square metres across the industrial unit, the data centre and its technical rooms, a current capacity of 100 racks, and a 130 centimetre raised floor with antistatic technical flooring in all rooms. Fire protection combines VESDA early smoke detection acting independently in each room, a 3M Novec 1230 suppression system, and fire rated floors and doors with intumescent brickwork. Electrical resilience is described as redundant supply, two standby generator sets, and an on-site photovoltaic plant, which is on-site generation rather than a utility service rating. No IT load figure, utility supply rating or generator rating is published for the site, and this registry records none rather than estimating one.

The building is carrier neutral, runs its own autonomous system, and takes redundant IP transit from at least three carriers. Trevenque holds ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification and Esquema Nacional de Seguridad category ALTA for its data centre services, states it was the first operator in Andalusia to certify at ENS High level, and maintains replicated capacity in Madrid. Services sold from the building include housing by rack unit, rack, cage or private room, hosting, private and public cloud, backup with geographic replication, S3 style object storage, remote hands and telecommunications antenna colocation. In January 2026 the company joined Spain's national SOC network as a cybersecurity service provider, and the data centre was recognised at the Data Center Market awards in 2026 for work carried out with Aquads Technologies. The OpenStreetMap footprint was first mapped in 2018 and given its Cloud Center Andalucia name and data centre tag in November 2019.
profile.research_note: Operator identified 2026-09-05 by following the abandoned brand domain: cloudcenterandalucia.es 301-redirects to trevenque.es. Trevenque Group publishes its data centre address as Calle Pago de Cambea nave 13, Parque Empresarial Cortijo del Conde, Poligono Sur, 18015 Granada, matching the OSM addr:street tag on way/591288487. All technical detail taken from Trevenque's own housing service page, data centre page, corporate history, offices page and security certificates page. No IT load, utility supply or generator rating is published, deliberately left blank. OSM provenance: footprint mapped 2018-05-27 by Jotaele_, named and tagged telecom=data_center 2019-11-17 by the same mapper, geometry refined 2025-02-28 by kapazao. Prior status was exhausted with a hedged placeholder, now replaced.
